useSelectedVehicle (web @/hooks/useSelectedVehicle) composes a localStorage-backed Context store (web store/selectedVehicle) with react-router URL precedence (useMatch '/vehicles/:id', useSearchParams '?vehicle_id=') and a default-to-first-vehicle effect. react-router + localStorage are browser-only, so the native port inlines a module-level shared store (selectedVehicleId + selectionListeners + setSelectedVehicleId/subscribeSelection/getSelectionSnapshot read via useSyncExternalStore) that preserves the cross-instance 'global selection' behaviour, the setVehicleId>0/Number.isFinite guard, and the default-to-first-vehicle effect, reading the fleet from the ported useVehicles() ('/vehicles'). The URL path/query precedence and localStorage persistence are intentionally dropped (no RN router/storage dep) — selection is shared in-memory for the app session, the same graceful degradation the web store documents for private-browsing/SSR. The unused web `vehicle` record field is omitted since VehicleSelect never reads it.

Empty-fleet guard L45 (if vehicles.length === 0 return null) preserved exactly, after all hooks run unconditionally (useNativeTranslationFallback, useSelectedVehicle -> useVehicles + useSyncExternalStore + useEffect, useState open) so hook order is stable.
